question: If x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}} then the value of x² - xy + y² over x² +xy + y² = ?
solution:
**Given:**

 x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}}

**Calculations:**

According to question,

 x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} 

⇒x = 9 - 4√5

⇒x² = 161 - 72√5

and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}} 

⇒y = 9 + 4√5

⇒y² = 161 + 72√5

Now, 

 x² - xy + y² over x² +xy + y²

= (161 - 72√5 - 1 + 161 + 72√5)/(161 - 72√5 + 1 + 161 + 72√5)

= (322 - 1)/(322 + 1)

= 321/323

**Hence, The Required value is 321/323.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

We know, if x = ((p - q))/((p + q)) and y = ((p + q))/((p - q)) then (x + y) = (2times (p² + q²))/((p² - q²))

 x = {{sqrt5 - sqrt4} over {sqrt5 + sqrt4}} and y = {{sqrt5 + sqrt4} over {sqrt5 - sqrt4}} so, x + y = (2(sqrt5² + sqrt4²))/((5 - 4)) = 18 and xy = 1

So, x² - xy + y² over x² +xy + y² = ((x + y)² - 3xy)/((x + y)² -xy) = (18² - 3)/(18² -1) = 321/323
